chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Abi Khadijah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“Linen was for the Children of Israel, with which they used to be shrouded, and cotton is for the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the community of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْقُطْنُ: cotton; the fabric designated here for the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْكَتَّانُ: linen; a fabric mentioned as the shrouding material for Bani Isra'il
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Israel; the earlier community referred to in the report
key_terms.يُكَفَّنُونَ: they were shrouded; used for burial wrapping

ai.seo_question: What material is mentioned for the shrouding of the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith states that linen was the shrouding material used for Bani Isra'il, while cotton is for the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله. It reflects a transmitted tradition concerning funerary practice and distinctions between religious communities.
